verdict.rationale: Shopify documents officially supported libraries for building apps (docs-18) and a CLI that scaffolds apps, themes and storefronts with a single command (docs-3, docs-17, docs-42, docs-30, probe-4). Dev stores connected through `shopify app dev` support testing (x2), and extensions integrate into admin, checkout and the storefront (docs-1, docs-8). However, the pack contains no documentation of an App Store review or submission/distribution process. Community reports describe opaque developer account bans (comm-7) and poor partner docs (comm-8), which lower confidence. Missing for 10: documented app review/distribution path, independent hands-on corroboration of the SDK/CLI developer experience.
